caption: Candles are lit beneath a wooden Christmas pyramid, and its fan blades start turning and the figures rotate.

sa.check: A wooden Christmas pyramid stands with candles beneath its fan blades.
The figures on the pyramid rotate.
The blades and figures are still before the candles are lit.
The lighting comes first and the turning follows.

pc.expect: The blades and figures stay still until the candles are lit, turn while they burn and slow to a stop when they are put out.
pc.fail: The blades turn before the candles are lit; or they keep turning at the same rate after the candles are out; or they turn while the candles stand unlit; or they stop and start again while the candles burn steadily.

pc.expect: The rising air from the flames turns the blades and the figures turn with them, on the same shaft.
pc.fail: The figures turn while the blades stand still; or the blades turn while the figures stay fixed; or the blades turn while the candles are plainly out; or the blades turn faster as the candles are blown out.

pc.expect: The blades turn about the pyramid's upright shaft in one direction and the tiers turn with them.
pc.fail: The blades reverse direction with nothing changing; or the blades wobble off the shaft; or a tier turns the opposite way to the blades on the same shaft; or the whole pyramid slides across the table as it turns.

pc.expect: The flames point upward at the blades and the melted wax runs down the candles.
pc.fail: A flame points downward; or a flame is drawn up into the blades and burns above them; or wax climbs a candle's side; or a flame hangs below its candle.

pc.expect: One pyramid with its blades, tiers and figures; the figures keep their number and stay on their tiers.
pc.fail: A figure vanishes; or a new figure appears on a tier; or a blade vanishes; or the pyramid's shaft passes through the table.

pc.expect: The pyramid's wood, the figures' paint and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The wood changes colour; or a figure's paint changes; or items in the room rearrange.
